changes.title: Explain investment terms on first use
changes.why: After the Q3 family report, two family members asked what TVPI and DPI meant. Terms the investment team uses every day are not plain English to the family.
changes.author: jamesgray007

changes.title: Verify wire changes only through contacts on file
changes.why: The quarterly security review flagged a known fraud pattern: a fake notice changes the bank details and prints a phone number to "confirm" them. The skill said to verify by call-back but not which number to call.
changes.author: jamesgray007

changes.title: Flag calls due in fewer than 5 business days
changes.why: A Fund IV call arrived with four business days to pay and sat in the queue behind routine notices. The office's rule is that short-notice calls go to the Controller first.
changes.author: jamesgray007

changes.title: Record netted distributions separately
changes.why: Two Fund II notices this quarter netted a distribution against the call. The skill recorded only the net amount, so the commitment check counted the call as $150,000 smaller than it was.
changes.author: jamesgray007
